name: MSI Power
author: Tanmay
description: MSI laptop control plus a system monitor in one bar widget: power modes, fan control and cooler boost, live CPU/EC sensors, CPU usage, RAM and storage — built on the msi-ec kernel driver, fully standalone (no MControlCenter).

barWidget.description: MSI laptop control and system monitor. All EC access goes straight to sysfs: reads are world-readable and writes are group-granted by the bundled one-shot udev setup (setup/grant-msi-ec-access.sh). MControlCenter and its root D-Bus helper are not required and never run.

schema.label: Hide the widget when msi-ec is not loaded
Auto power mode on power-source change
Temp (°C) that turns the bar icon red
